The atom symbol cue borrows from the universal science tradition and the modern 'science time' aesthetic, which is exactly why the emoji reads as particle-coded rather than literal atom symbol.

In real-world usage ⚛️ lives in the spaces where the sender wants to communicate physics-coded comfort. A partner sends it on an 'atom symbol for you ⚛️' check-in.
